verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              अध्यात्मं नाम यदिदं पुरुषस्येह चिन्त्यते । यदध्यात्मं यथा चैतत्तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह ॥१॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said Tell me, O grandfather, what and of what nature is that which passes by the name of Adhyatma (spiritual) and which is laid down for ever person.

verses.sanskrit: कुतः सृष्टमिदं विश्वं ब्रह्मन् स्थावरजङ्गमम् । प्रलये कथमभ्येति तन्मे वक्तुमिहार्हसि ॥२॥
verses.english: O you who are acquainted with Brahma, whence has this universe, consisting of inobile and immobile objects, been created? When universal dissolution sets in, to whom does it go? You should describe this subject to me.

verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              अध्यात्ममिति मां पार्थ यदेतदनुपृच्छसि । तद्व्याख्यास्यामि ते तात श्रेयस्करतमं सुखम् ॥३॥
verses.english: Bhishma said This Adhyatma, O son of Pritha, that you ask me about, I will presently describe. It is, O son, highly agreeable and productive of great happiness.

verses.sanskrit: सृष्टिप्रलयसंयुक्तमाचार्यैः परिदर्शितम् । यज्ज्ञात्वा पुरुषो लोके प्रीतिं सौख्यं च विन्दति । फललाभश्च तस्य स्यात् सर्वभूतहितं च तत् ॥४॥
verses.english: Great teachers have (before this) described the Creation and the Destruction of the universe). Knowing those truths, a person may acquire, even in this world, great satisfaction and happiness. Such knowledge also bring on the acquisition of great fruits, and it is highly beneficial to all creatures.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम् । महाभूतानि भूतानां सर्वेषां प्रभवाप्ययौ ॥५॥
यतः सृष्टानि तत्रैव तानि यान्ति पुनः पुनः । महाभूतानि भूतेभ्यः सागरस्योर्मयो यथा ॥६॥
verses.english: To Him from whom these great primal elements spring, they return again and again severing themselves from all creatures like the wave of the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसार्य च यथाऽङ्गानि कूर्मः संहरते पुनः । तद्वद्भूतानि भूतात्मा सृष्टानि हरते पुनः ॥७॥
verses.english: As the tortoise extends its limbs and withdraws them again, so the Supreme Soul creates all objects and again withdraws them into Himself.

verses.sanskrit: महाभूतानि पञ्चैव सर्वभूतेषु भूतकृत् । अकरोत्तेषु वैषम्यं तत्तु जीवो न पश्यति ॥८॥
शब्दः श्रोत्रं तथा खानि त्रयमाकाशयोनिजम् । वायोः स्पर्शस्तथा चेष्टा त्वक्चैव त्रितयं स्मृतम् ॥९॥
verses.english: Sound, the organ of hearing, and all holes,-these three, originate from Space Touch, action, and skin are the three-fold attributes of the Wind.

verses.sanskrit: रूपं चक्षुस्तथा पाकस्त्रिविधं तेज उच्यते । रसः क्लेदश्च जिह्वा च त्रयो जलगुणाः स्मृताः ॥१०॥
verses.english: Form, cye, and digestion are the three-fold attributes of Fire or Energy. Taste all liquid secretions, and the tongue are the three attributes of Water.

verses.sanskrit: घ्रेयं घ्राणं शरीरं च एते भूमिगुणास्त्रयः । महाभूतानि पञ्चैव षष्ठं च मन उच्यते ॥११॥
verses.english: Smell, the nose, and the body are the three properties, of Earth. The great elements are five. The mind is the sixth.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणि मनश्चैव विज्ञानान्यस्य भारत । सप्तमी बुद्धिरित्याहुः क्षेत्रज्ञः पुनरष्टमः ॥१२॥
verses.english: The senses and the mind, O Bharata are the organs through which the cognition of a living creature is made. The seventh is the understanding; and the eight is the soul.

verses.sanskrit: चक्षुरालोचनायैव संशयं कुरुते मनः । बुद्धिरध्यवसानाय क्षेत्रज्ञः साक्षिवत् स्थितः ॥१३॥
verses.english: The senses are for perceiving; the mind creates uncertainty. The understanding brings all knowledge to certainty. The Soul exists as a witness.

verses.sanskrit: उर्ध्वं पादतलाभ्यां यदर्वाक्चोर्ध्वं च पश्यति । एतेन सर्वमेवेदं विद्ध्यभिव्याप्तमन्तरम् ॥१४॥
verses.english: All that is above the two feet, all that is behind, and all that is above, are witnessed by the Soul. Know that the Soul permeates the entire being without left vacant.

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषैरिन्द्रियाणीह वेदितव्यानि कृत्स्नशः । तमो रजश्च सत्त्वं च तेऽपि भावास्तदाश्रिताः ॥१५॥
verses.english: All men should know fully the senses, the mind and the understanding. The three universal tendencies qualities called Goodness, Darkness and Ignorance, exist, dependent on the senses, the mind, and the understanding.

verses.sanskrit: एतां बुद्ध्वा नरा बुद्ध्या भूतानामागतिं गतिम् । समवेक्ष्य शनैश्चैव लभते शममुत्तमम् ॥१६॥
verses.english: Man, by understanding with the help of his intelligence, the manner in which creatures come and leave the world, is sure to attain by and by to steadfast peace.

verses.sanskrit: गुणैर्नेनीयते बुद्धिर्बुद्धेरेवेन्द्रियाण्यपि । मनःषष्ठानि सर्वाणि तदभावे कुतो गुणाः ॥१७॥
verses.english: or The three qualities lead the understanding to worldly attachments. In this matter, the Understanding is identical with the Senses and the Mind. The Understanding, therefore, is identical with the six (the five senses and the mind), and also with the objects cognised by it. When, however, the Understanding is destroyed, the three qualities cannot produce action.

verses.sanskrit: इति तन्मयमेवैतत्सर्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम् । प्रलीयते चोद्भवति तस्मान्निर्दिश्यते तथा ॥१८॥
verses.english: This universe of mobile and iinmobile objects consists of that Intelligence. It is from that Intelligence that everything originales and it is into it that everything originates and it is into it that everything subsides. The scriptures point out, therefore, that everything is a manifestation of Intelligence.

verses.sanskrit: येन पश्यति तच्चक्षुः शृणोति श्रोत्रमुच्यते । जिघ्रति घ्राणमित्याहू रसं जानाति जिह्वया ॥१९॥
verses.english: That by which one sees, that is eye hears is the car. That by which one smells is called the organ of smell, and that by which one distinguishes the tastes is called the tongue.

verses.sanskrit: त्वचा स्पर्शयते स्पर्शं बुद्धिर्विक्रियते सकृत् । येन प्रार्थयते किञ्चित्तदा भवति तन्मनः ॥२०॥
verses.english: One acquires perception of touch by the skin that covers the body. That which is called the Intelligence undergoes changes. When the Intelligence desires anything it is called Mind.

verses.sanskrit: अधिष्ठानानि बुद्धेर्हि पृथगर्थानि पञ्चधा । इन्द्रियाणीति यान्याहुस्तान्यदृश्योऽधितिष्ठति ॥२१॥
verses.english: The foundations of the Intelligence are five in number, cach serving a different purpose. They are called the sense. The invisible principle. viz., Intelligence, Depends on them.

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषे तिष्ठती बुद्धिस्त्रिषु भावेषु वर्तते । कदाचिल्लभते प्रीतिं कदाचिदनुशोचति ॥२२॥
verses.english: The Intelligence that exists in a living creature embraces the three qualities. Sometimes it obtains happiness and sometimes misery.

verses.sanskrit: न सुखेन न दुःखेन कदाचिदपि वर्तते । एवं नराणां मनसि त्रिषु भावेष्ववस्थिता ॥२३॥
verses.english: Sometimes it becomes shorn of both joy and misery. Thus Intelligence exists on the minds of all men.

verses.sanskrit: सेयं भावात्मिका भावांस्त्रीनेतानतिवर्तते । सरितां सागरो भर्ता महावेलामिवोर्मिमान् ॥२४॥
अतिभावगता बुद्धिर्भावे मनसि वर्तते । प्रवर्तमानं तु रजस्तद्भावमनुवर्तते ॥२५॥
verses.english: That Intelligence which transcends the three qualities exists in the mind in a purc state, of (unmodified) existence alone. The quality of Darkness, however, that leads to action, soon pursues it.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणि हि सर्वाणि प्रवर्तयति सा तदा । ततः सत्त्वं तमोभावः प्रीतियोगात्प्रवर्तते ॥२६॥
verses.english: At that time the Intelligence sets and the senses to action. The properties of the three are these : happiness dwell in Goodness; sorrow in Darkness; delusion in Ignorance.

verses.sanskrit: प्रीतिः सत्त्वं रजः शोकस्तमो मोहस्तु ते त्रयः । ये ये च भावा लोकेऽस्मिन् सर्वेष्वेतेषु वै त्रिषु ॥२७॥
इति बुद्धिगतिः सर्वा व्याख्याता तव भारत । इन्द्रियाणि च सर्वाणि विजेतव्यानि धीमता ॥२८॥
verses.english: All the states of the mind are included in the three qualities. I have now, O Bharata, described to you the course of the understanding.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चैव प्राणिनां संश्रिताः सदा । त्रिविधा वेदना चैव सर्वसत्त्वेषु दृश्यते ॥२९॥
verses.english: An intelligent man should control all his senses. The three qualities of Goodness, Darkness and Ignorance are always attached to living creatures.

verses.sanskrit: सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति भारत । सुखस्पर्शः सत्त्वगुणो दुःखस्पर्शो रजोगुणः । तमोगुणेन संयुक्तौ भवतो व्यावहारिकौ ॥३०॥
verses.english: Three kinds of intelligence also are seen in every creature, viz., that which depends upon Goodness, that upon darkness, and that upon Ignorance, O Bharata.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र यत्प्रीतिसंयुक्तं काये मनसि वा भवेत् । वर्तते सात्त्विको भाव इत्याचक्षीत तत्तथा ॥३१॥
verses.english: Every state of happiness that appears in the body or the mind is due to the quality of Goodness.

verses.sanskrit: अथ यद्दुःखसंयुक्तमप्रीतिकरमात्मनः । प्रवृत्तं रज इत्येव तन्न संरभ्य चिन्तयेत् ॥३२॥
verses.english: A disagreeable state of sorrow to oneself, is due to nothing but the quality of Darkness. One should never think of it in fear.

verses.sanskrit: अथ यन्मोहसंयुक्तमव्यक्तविषयं भवेत् । अप्रतर्क्यमविज्ञेयं तमस्तदुपधारयेत् ॥३३॥
verses.english: That state, which is full of delusion and error, and for which one knows not what to do, which is unascertainable and unknown, should be regarded as belonging to the quality of Ignorance.

verses.sanskrit: प्रहर्षः प्रीतिरानन्दः सुखं संशान्तचित्तता । कथञ्चिदभिवर्तन्त इत्येते सात्त्विका गुणाः ॥३४॥
verses.english: Joy, satisfaction, delight, happiness, tranquillity of heart, these are the properties of the state of Goodness. Man sometimes acquires a portion of them.

verses.sanskrit: अतुष्टिः परितापश्च शोको लोभस्तथाऽक्षमा । लिङ्गानि रजसस्तानि दृश्यन्ते हेत्वहेतुभिः ॥३५॥
verses.english: Discontent, heart-burning, grief, cupidity, vindictiveness, are all marks of darkness. They are seen with or without sufficient causes for producing them.

verses.sanskrit: अवमानस्तथा मोहः प्रमादः स्वप्नतन्द्रिता । कथञ्चिदभिवर्तन्ते विविधास्तामसा गुणाः ॥३६॥
verses.english: Disgrace, delusion, error, slcep and stupefaction, that befall one through excess of ill-luck, are various properties of the state of Jgnorance.

verses.sanskrit: दूरगं बहुधागामि प्रार्थनासंशयात्मकम् । मनः सुनियतं यस्य स सुखी प्रेत्य चेह च ॥३७॥
सत्त्वक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेतदन्तरं पश्य सूक्ष्मयोः । सृजते तु गुणानेक एको न सृजते गुणान् ॥३८॥
verses.english: Mark the differences between those two subtile things, viz., Intelligence and the Soul. One of these viz., Intelligence (displays of qualities. The other viz., the Soul) does nothing of the kind.

verses.sanskrit: मशकोदुम्बरौ वापि सम्प्रयुक्तौ यथा सदा । अन्योन्यमेतौ स्यातां च सम्प्रयोगस्तथा तयोः ॥३९॥
verses.english: A gnat and a fig may be seen to be united with each other. Though united, each, however, is separate from the other.

verses.sanskrit: पृथग्भूतौ प्रकृत्या तौ सम्प्रयुक्तौ च सर्वदा । यथा मत्स्यौ जलं चैव सम्प्रयुक्तौ तथैव तौ ॥४०॥
verses.english: Likewise, Intelligence and Soul, though different from each other, by their by their respective natures, yet they may always be seen to exist in a state of union. A fish and water exist together. But cach, however, the case with Intelligence and Soul.

verses.sanskrit: न गुणा विदुरात्मानं स गुणान्वेत्ति सर्वशः । परिद्रष्टा गुणानां तु संसृष्टान्मन्यते तथा ॥४१॥
verses.english: The qualities do not know the Soul, but the Soul knows them all. The Soul is the spectator of the qualities and consider them all as emanating from itself.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियैस्तु प्रदीपार्थं कुरुते बुद्धिसप्तमैः । निर्विचेष्टैरजानद्भिः परमात्मा प्रदीपवत् ॥४२॥
verses.english: Acting through the senses, the mind, and the understanding which is the seventh, all of which are inactive and have no self-consciousness, the Soul discovers the objects like a lamp showing all objects around it by shedding its rays through an opening in the covering.

verses.sanskrit: सृजते हि गुणान् सत्त्वं क्षेत्रज्ञः परिपश्यति । सम्प्रयोगस्तयोरेष सत्त्वक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ध्रुवः ॥४३॥
verses.english: The understanding or Intelligence creates all the qualities. The Soul only sees them. Such is certainly the connection between the Intelligence and the Soul.

verses.sanskrit: आश्रयो नास्ति सत्त्वस्य क्षेत्रज्ञस्य च कश्चन । सत्त्वं मनः संसृजते न गुणान्वै कदाचन ॥४४॥
verses.english: There is no resort of cither Intelligence or Soul. The understanding creates the mind, but never the qualities.

verses.sanskrit: रश्मींस्तेषां स मनसा यदा सम्यङ्नियच्छति । तदा प्रकाशतेऽस्यात्मा घटे दीपो ज्वलन्निव ॥४५॥
verses.english: When the Soul, by means of the mind, sufficiently controls the rays that proved from the senses, it is then that it becomes visible (10 the Understanding) like a lamp burning within a cover.

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा यः प्राकृतं कर्म नित्यमात्मरतिर्मुनिः । सर्वभूतात्मभूस्तस्मात् स गच्छेदुत्तमां गतिम् ॥४६॥
verses.english: That person who renounces all ordinary acts, practises penances, devotes himself to Study the Soul, taking a delight in it, and regards himself as the Soul of all creatures, acquires a supreme end.

verses.sanskrit: यथा वारिचरः पक्षी सलिलेन न लिप्यते । एवमेव कृतप्रज्ञो भूतेषु परिवर्तते ॥४७॥
verses.english: As an aquatic bird while moving over the waters, is never welted, so does a wise person move among creatures.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्वभावमेवैतत्स्वबुद्ध्या विहरेन्नरः । अशोचन्नप्रहृष्यंश्च समो विगतमत्सरः ॥४८॥
verses.english: One should act in the world, by the help of his intelligence, in this way, without grief, without joy, without distinction of personality, for all, and shorn of malice and envy,

verses.sanskrit: स्वभावयुक्त्या युक्तस्तु स नित्यं सृजते गुणान् । उर्णनाभिर्यथा सूत्रं विज्ञेयास्तन्तुवद्गुणाः ॥४९॥
verses.english: One living in this way creates the qualities (i.e. transcends them), like a spider creating threads. The qualities should indeed, be considered as the threads of the spider.

verses.sanskrit: प्रध्वस्ता न निवर्तन्ते निवृत्तिर्नोपलभ्यते । प्रत्यक्षेण परोक्षं तदनुमानेन सिध्यति ॥५०॥
verses.english: Some say that the qualities of such men are not lost. Some say that they are all lost. Those who say that they are not lost rely upon the Shrutis, which do not contain any declaration to the contrary. They, however, who say, that the qualities are all lost rely on the Smritis. One should taking into consideration both these opinions, judge as to which of them is right.

verses.sanskrit: एवमेकेऽध्यवस्यन्ति निवृत्तिरिति चापरे । उभयं सम्प्रधार्यैतद्व्यवस्येत यथामति ॥५१॥
इतीमं हृदयग्रन्थिं बुद्धिभेदमयं दृढम् । विमुच्य सुखमासीत न शोचेच्छिन्नसंशयः ॥५२॥
verses.english: One should thus solve the knotty question which is capable of shaking the understanding by doubt, and thereby acquire happiness. When that doubt will be removed, one will no longer : have to grieve.

verses.sanskrit: मलिनाः प्राप्नुयुः सिद्धिं यथा पूर्णां नदीं नराः । अवगाह्य सुविद्वांसो विद्धि ज्ञानमिदं तथा ॥५३॥
verses.english: Men of impure hearts may by knowledge acquire success like persons plunging in a full river purifying themselves of all dirts.

verses.sanskrit: महानद्या हि पारज्ञस्तप्यते न तदन्यथा । न तु तुप्यति तत्त्वज्ञः फले ज्ञाते तरत्युत ॥५४॥
verses.english: One who has to get over large river, does not feel happy at only seeing the other shore. If the case were otherwise, (i. c., if by merely sceing the other shore he could reach it) then might one become happy. It is quite different with one acquainted with truth. The mere knowledge of Truth will give him happiness. As soon as such knowledge begins to fructify, the person may be considered to have reached the other shore. They who thus know the Soul as freed from all worldly objects and is but the One, are said to acquire high and excellent knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ये विदुराध्यात्मं केवलं ज्ञानमुत्तमम् ॥५५॥
verses.english: By knowing the origin and the end of all creatures, a person which is such, and by thinking upon the subject, a person by and by obtains infinite reality.

verses.sanskrit: एतां बुद्ध्वा नरः सर्वां भूतानामागतिं गतिम् । अवेक्ष्य च शनैर्बुद्ध्या लभते शमनं ततः ॥५६॥
verses.english: He who has understood the three-fold objects and reflecting upon it, casts it away, succeeds by Yoga to see the Truth and secure perfect happiness.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिवर्गो यस्य विदितः प्रेक्ष्य यश्च विमुञ्चति । अन्विष्य मनसा युक्तस्तत्त्वदर्शी निरुत्सुकः ॥५७॥
verses.english: The Soul cannot be seen unless the senses, which are set on various objects and are difficult of being controlled, be all duly restrained.

verses.sanskrit: न चात्मा शक्यते द्रष्टुमिन्द्रियैश्च विभागशः । तत्र तत्र विसृष्टैश्च दुर्वार्यैश्चाकृतात्मभिः ॥५८॥
verses.english: He who knows this, is really wise. What other mark is there of a wise man? Acquiring this knowledge, intelligent men considered themselves to be crowned with success.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्बुद्ध्वा भवेद्बुद्धः किमन्यद्बुद्धलक्षणम् । विज्ञाय तद्धि मन्यन्ते कृतकृत्या मनीषिणः ॥५९॥
verses.english: That which strikes the Ignorant with fear can never create fear in persons of Knowledge. There is no higher and for anybody than Liberation. The sages say that on account of the excess or otherwise of good qualities, differences are seen regarding the degree of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: न भवति विदुषां ततो भयं यदविदुषां सुमहद्भयं भवेत् । न हि गतिरधिकास्ति कस्यचित् सति हि गुणे प्रवदन्त्यतुल्यताम् ॥६०॥
यः करोत्यनभिसन्धिपूर्वकं तच्च निर्गुदति यत्पुराकृतम् । नाप्रियं तदुभयं कुतः प्रियं तस्य तज्जनयतीह सर्वतः ॥६१॥
verses.english: People blame a person who is possessed of lust, envy, and other evil passions). Those vices draw the person down in his next life into various sorts of inferior births.

verses.sanskrit: लोकमातुरमसूयते जनस्तस्य तज्जनयतीह सर्वतः ॥६२॥
verses.english: Mark attentively the vicious in this world who grieve exceedingly for the loss of their possessions. See also those who are gifted with judgement and who never grieve when placed in similar circumstances! Those who are conversant with both, deserve to be called truly wise..

verses.sanskrit: लोक आतुरजनान्निरावशंस्तत्तदेव बहु पश्य शोचतः । तत्र पश्य कुशलानशोचतो ये विदुस्तदुभयं पदं सताम् ॥६३॥
